description: 4 Mics with AI-ENx Technology: Experience crystal-clear conversations wherever you are with the 4 mics in boAt Airdopes Prime 413 TWS Earbuds. Powered by AI-ENx technology, these earbuds block out background noise for effortless calls. Multipoint Connectivity: Multitask like a pro with multipoint connectivity that lets you stay connected to both your laptop and phone at the same time. Whether it's a call or a virtual meeting, switch between devices seamlessly. boAt Hearables App Support: Take control of your audio with the boAt Hearables app. From battery and connectivity status to activating or deactivating features, shuffling EQ presets, and customizing your sound - it’s all just a tap away. 50 Hours Playback: Your all-time audio companion! With a whopping 50 hours of total playback, keep your playlists, podcasts, and game soundtracks running without worrying about recharging. Google Fast Pair: Say goodbye to pairing delays! One tap is all it takes to instantly connect with Google Fast Pair. You can even rename your Airdopes or locate misplaced buds effortlessly. Advanced Bluetooth v6.0: Enjoy a more stable and reliable wireless experience with Bluetooth v6.0. Be it streaming matches, bingeing on shows, or catching up on music, you can stay connected without pesky drops. Low-Latency BEAST Mode: Unleash your inner gamer with BEAST Mode! 60 ms low latency ensures your actions sync perfectly with the audio for lag-free, immersive gameplay. 12 mm Drivers with boAt Signature Sound: Dive into deep bass and rich audio with the dual 12 mm drivers. Escape the noise and tune into the vibrant boAt Signature Sound that brings your content to life. ASAP Charge: Just 10 minutes of ASAP Charge gives you a whopping 150 minutes of playtime for quick power-ups between calls or binge-watching sessions. IPX5 Water Resistance: Workout or chill by the pool without worries as Airdopes Prime 413 is built to handle it all with IPX5 resistance to protect against sweat and splashes.
